caption: An opaque metal jug is tipped over an empty glass, and water pours out of it into the glass.

sa.check: An opaque metal jug is tipped over an empty glass.
Water pours out of the spout.
The water goes into the glass.
The glass is empty at the start.
The tip comes first and the pour follows.

pc.expect: Water appears only from the spout once the jug tilts far enough, and the level in the glass rises.
pc.fail: Water appears in the glass with no stream; or water comes from the jug's side; or the glass level does not rise.

pc.expect: The stream is a liquid, and the jug's sides stay opaque and rigid.
pc.fail: The stream is a rigid rod; or the jug becomes transparent; or the jug bulges.

pc.expect: The stream falls straight down into the glass.
pc.fail: It curves upward; or hangs; or flows back into the jug.

pc.expect: Pouring happens only while the jug is tilted.
pc.fail: It pours upright; or is tilted with nothing coming out; or continues after it is righted.

pc.expect: One jug and one glass keep their number.
pc.fail: The jug duplicates; or water passes through the glass; or the jug vanishes.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The jug, the glass and the background stay the same.
pc.fail: The jug changes colour; or the glass changes; or the background rearranges.
